cues.en: Hey, it's Andre here again with another quick note.
cues.zh: 嘿，我是 Andrei，再帶來一個小提醒。

cues.en: Now, if you want, you can pause the video and read this little comic by xkcd.
cues.zh: 如果願意，可以暫停影片，閱讀這則 xkcd 小漫畫。

cues.en: But I want to talk quickly about data visualizations.
cues.zh: 不過，我想簡單談談資料視覺化。

cues.en: Now, we talked about this idea of exploring our data.
cues.zh: 之前談過探索資料的概念。

cues.en: Right.
cues.zh: 對吧？

cues.en: And we can explore our data by looking at something like mean or variance or any statistical method to explore our data.
cues.zh: 我們可以查看平均值、變異數，或使用任何統計方法來探索資料。

cues.en: But data visualization is another method we can use along with statistics to explore our data.
cues.zh: 而資料視覺化，是能搭配統計，一起探索資料的另一種方法。

cues.en: So we often create these data visualizations like graphs to derive meaning from data.
cues.zh: 所以，我們常建立圖表等視覺化內容，從資料中找出意義。

cues.en: But it's easy to make graphs that are meaningless or misleading.
cues.zh: 但也很容易做出沒有意義，或具有誤導性的圖表。

cues.en: And your job as a data scientist is not just to make pretty graphs and pretty visualizations, but to make visualizations that are actually meaningful and that are accurate.
cues.zh: 資料科學家的工作，不只是做漂亮的圖表與視覺化，而是做出真正有意義、而且準確的視覺化。

cues.en: For example, access is important.
cues.zh: 例如，座標軸很重要。

cues.en: You need to know what the x axis and y axis is here.
cues.zh: 必須知道這裡的 X 軸與 Y 軸代表什麼。

cues.en: Otherwise, well, this graph is completely meaningless because we have no idea what it's measuring.
cues.zh: 否則，這張圖就完全沒有意義，因為根本不知道它在測量什麼。

cues.en: This is a common mistake with beginners.
cues.zh: 這是初學者常犯的錯。

cues.en: That is, we assume that a graph is always telling the truth and we jump to conclusions right away from data.
cues.zh: 也就是假設圖表一定在說真話，立刻從資料跳到結論。

cues.en: Instead, we want to pause and reflect and make sure that whatever we're visualizing is accurate and testing it with different methods, trying different visualizations.
cues.zh: 我們反而應該停下來思考，確認呈現的內容準確，再用不同方法測試，嘗試不同的視覺化方式。

cues.en: We don't want to jump to conclusions right away from data.
cues.zh: 不要立刻從資料跳到結論。

cues.en: It takes a lot to understand this data.
cues.zh: 要理解這些資料，需要不少努力。

cues.en: So just a quick note.
cues.zh: 所以，簡單提醒一下。

cues.en: That is, just because we have data doesn't mean we have knowledge.
cues.zh: 有資料，不代表就有知識。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Back to work.
cues.zh: 繼續工作。
